chapter_path_en: Risks and Methods of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing
chapter_path_zh: 洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法
display_chapter_path: 洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法
stem: 从宏观层面来看,风险评估流程包括识别和评估与客户、产品、国家以及交付渠道相关的固有风险,然后:

options.A: 将这些风险与行业基准进行比较,以确定剩余风险.
options.B: 实施新的控制措施以消除所有风险
options.C: 评估相关控制措施的有效性,以计算剩余风险.
options.D: 记录历史风险事件以供未来参考.

stem_en: At a high level, the risk assessment process involves identifying and rating the inherent risks associated with customers, products, countries, and delivery channels and then:

options_en.A: Comparing these risks with industry benchmarks to determine the residual risk
options_en.B: Implementing new controls to eliminate all risks
options_en.C: Rating the effectiveness of the related controls in order to calculate the residual risk
options_en.D: Documenting historical risk incidents for future reference
